card.name: News text: dates, numbers, sentence breaks
card.fires_on: Punctuation, numbers and small linking words in general news and web text, such as a year digit, a closing bracket or dash in a headline list, or the word In at a sentence start. It is not tied to drug-label text.

modes.label: Numbers and ordinals
modes.description: Last digit of a year or the th after a number in news or catalog text.
modes.example: 8 CDs. 8:19 hrs. Prod. by Listening Library. Dist. by Listening Library/Books on Tape. 201<<2>>. ISBN 978-0

modes.label: Punctuation in headline lists
modes.description: Closing brackets, dashes and periods between news items or sentences.
modes.example: home, damages business in Waterford (3) - Despite Angelina Jolie, breast cancer treatment has a long way to go - COLUMN (2<<) >>- PITTS: Woman ran to Key

modes.label: Sentence openers and commas
modes.description: Small words or commas after a place or dateline in news reports.
modes.example: At the climate talks in Doha<<,>> negotiations over Kyoto started yesterday.

card.writes: It lowers words like new, edition and updated, so it pushes against version or newness wording.
card.plain: It fires on small bits of news text like years, brackets and dashes, and it makes words like new or edition less likely next.
